projects.name: Kapman (KDE)
projects.note: KDE Games Pac-Man clone with SVG themes; maintained with KDE Gear releases.

projects.name: pacman-canvas
projects.note: HTML5 canvas clone; successor 'pacman-canvas-next' (MIT) unplayable.

projects.name: pacman.c / pacman.zig (floooh)
projects.note: Arcade-accurate minimal remake using sokol; uses recreated original maze/sprites.

projects.name: neon_pacman (CyberSheepYT)
projects.note: Tiny single-file hobby project with bloom, particles, CRT overlay: shows the idea but not a full product.

pacman.official_modern: Pac-Man Championship Edition / CE DX / CE 2 (Bandai Namco, commercial), Pac-Man 256, Pac-Man 99, Pac-Man World Re-Pac, Shadow Labyrinth (2025).
pacman.gap_note: Dozens of free clones exist but all are retro-faithful; only tiny hobby 'neon' web demos attempt CE-style glow. The CE vibe is owned by commercial Bandai Namco titles; no polished open-source equivalent exists.

projects.name: Qixxy
projects.note: Only Qix entry on OSGC; complete but minimal.

projects.name: aXonix
projects.note: Xonix-variant remake.

projects.name: Trappy Pixel
projects.note: Free Qix/Xonix/JezzBall-style game with polished pixel-art presentation; not open source.

qix.official_modern: Qix++ (Taito/Square Enix, 2009 XBLA); Qix appears in Taito compilations (Egret II Mini etc.).
qix.gap_note: Only small hobby clones exist, none open source with modern effects; Qix's line-drawing/area-fill is ideal for neon/glow treatment and nobody has done it.

projects.name: Lix
projects.note: 700+ original puzzles, networked multiplayer, level editor; v0.10.35 released Sep 2026. Pixel style.

projects.name: Pingus
projects.note: Penguin Lemmings clone with hi-res painted 2D graphics and editor; commits sporadic, last release 0.7.6 (2011).

projects.name: NeoLemmix
projects.note: Main community engine with huge custom level-pack scene and editor; original levels available as packs (unverified).

projects.name: Lemmings.ts
projects.note: Browser engine port that loads original Lemmings data (commercial content).

lemmings.official_modern: Lemmings (Sad Puppy/Sony, 2018 free-to-play mobile) and Lemmings: The Puzzle Adventure; Lemmings (2006 PSP/PS2 remake).
lemmings.gap_note: Excellent free/open gameplay clones (Lix, Pingus) with level editors exist, but all are pixel or dated 2D; no open project offers a modern lit/3D 'premium' presentation.

projects.name: Mr.Boom
projects.note: 8-player Bomberman clone with netplay and bots; pixel-art; most-played open clone.

projects.name: Granatier (KDE)
projects.note: KDE clone with SVG themes and arenas files.

projects.name: Bombermaaan
projects.note: Classic SDL remake of Bomberman / Atomic Bomberman.

projects.name: BombSquad / Ballistica engine
projects.note: Polished 3D physics party game built around bombs; not a Bomberman grid game but proves a modern-looking open bomb-arena engine exists.

bomberman.official_modern: Super Bomberman R / R 2 (Konami, 2017/2023), Amazing Bomberman (Apple Arcade), Bomberman Collection (2025).
bomberman.gap_note: Many free grid clones are all retro; BombSquad is modern and open-source but a different (physics brawler) game. A premium-looking grid Bomberman with open licence is still missing.

projects.name: LBreakoutHD
projects.note: 16:9 hi-res remaster of LBreakout2 with effects; thousands of community levelsets and editor (from LBreakout2).

projects.name: TecnoballZ
projects.note: Port of Amiga TecnoBall; retro pixel art.

projects.name: Briquolo
projects.note: Early OpenGL 3D breakout with explosions, camera angles and level editor; dated 2000s 3D.

projects.name: DX-Ball
projects.note: Classic freeware; DX-Ball 2 and later are commercial.

arkanoid.official_modern: Arkanoid: Eternal Battle (2022, Microids/Taito); Arkanoid vs Space Invaders (mobile); Shatter (Sidhe, commercial spiritual successor with premium look).
arkanoid.gap_note: LBreakoutHD is an actively maintained open remaster with mild effects, but its look is still 2000s-era; nothing free reaches Shatter/Tetris-Effect-level presentation.

projects.name: Froggix
projects.note: Playable Python remake, development halted.

projects.name: Saving Sue
projects.note: Perl/SDL Frogger clone.

projects.name: Frogger Remake (Lajawi)
projects.note: One of many small itch.io student remakes.

frogger.official_modern: Frogger in Toy Town (Konami, 2019 Apple Arcade), Frogger's Adventures series; Crossy Road (commercial free-to-play spiritual successor, voxel 3D).
frogger.gap_note: Only student/hobby clones exist; no maintained open-source Frogger, let alone a modern-looking one.

projects.name: digdug (l-hackari)
projects.note: Hobby Allegro remake.

projects.name: JavaDigDugGame (leonardo-ono)
projects.note: Faithful Java 2D recreation.

projects.name: Dig Dug Revival (LC-Games)
projects.note: Free homage with procedurally generated playfields; retro look.

projects.name: Digger Remastered
projects.note: Open remake of 1983 Digger, a Dig Dug-like title; related rather than Dig Dug itself.

digdug.official_modern: Dig Dug Deeper (2001, PC 3D); Mr. Driller series / Mr. Driller DrillLand (2022) is Namco's modern successor.
digdug.gap_note: Only small hobby and retro-look remakes; nothing open and maintained, nothing with modern presentation.

projects.name: Lupengo
projects.note: Only Pengo clone listed on OSGC.

projects.name: Pango
projects.note: Classic freeware DOS conversion of Pengo.

projects.name: SinLuces_Pengo
projects.note: Small free itch.io remake.

pengo.official_modern: No modern official remake; Pengo only in Sega compilations (e.g. Sega Ages / Astro City Mini).
pengo.gap_note: Only tiny, dated or jam-level clones; the ice-sliding mechanic is untouched by any modern free remake.

projects.name: The Bub's Brothers
projects.note: Networked multiplayer Bubble Bobble-like; pixel art; halted.

projects.name: Bubble Bobble Nostalgie
projects.note: Faithful Windows remake; listed as free-to-try $14.95 on download sites.

projects.name: Bubble Bobble C64 fan remaster
projects.note: Unofficial enhanced C64 port remaster (itch.io).

bubblebobble.official_modern: Bubble Bobble 4 Friends (Taito/ININ, 2019-2021), Bubble Bobble Double (mobile), Bubble Bobble Evolution (PSP).
bubblebobble.gap_note: Surprisingly thin free scene: no maintained open-source Bubble Bobble clone and nothing with modern visuals.

projects.name: xrick
projects.note: Reverse-engineered engine; ships original Core Design data with tolerance, not truly free assets.

projects.name: RickyD
projects.note: C++/SDL2 remake.

projects.name: Rick Dangerous DX / Amiga remaster (Z-Team)
projects.note: Remastered hi-colour graphics by Domkid; retro platforms only.

projects.name: Rick Dangerous 3D (polobuilder)
projects.note: One-month student 3D remake; partial.

rickdangerous.official_modern: No official modern remake (Rick Dangerous rights with Square Enix/Eidos; DX edition existed on Wii homebrew/port).
rickdangerous.gap_note: Free versions are either engine ports needing original assets or retro-platform remasters; no open, modern-looking PC remake.

projects.name: KGoldrunner (KDE)
projects.note: Maintained KDE clone with many original-style level sets and editor; themeable SVG graphics.

projects.name: Lode Runner - Total Recall
projects.note: Browser recreation with original Apple II level sets and editor.

projects.name: Lode Runner 2020
projects.note: OpenGL 4.6 remake based on NES version with original Apple II levels.

loderunner.official_modern: Lode Runner Legacy (Tozai, 2017, voxel 3D with editor); Lode Runner 1 (2023, Tozai) (unverified).
loderunner.gap_note: Solid free clones with editors and original levels exist but all look retro; the modern-look slot is taken only by commercial Lode Runner Legacy.

projects.name: JSoko
projects.note: Feature-rich Sokoban with solver and huge level collections.

projects.name: YASC
projects.note: Long-maintained Sokoban with skins/solver.

projects.name: Skladnik (KDE)
projects.note: KDE Sokoban.

projects.name: Sokobano
projects.note: 3D OpenGL rendering; dated.

sokoban.official_modern: Sokoban Touch / Sokoban series (Falcon); countless commercial spiritual successors with premium look (Baba Is You, Patrick's Parabox, Stephen's Sausage Roll).
sokoban.gap_note: Plenty of free faithful clones with the classic level collections (levels themselves widely freely shared), but none free and modern-looking.

projects.name: Chuckie Egg: The Next Batch (Retrospec)
projects.note: Retrospec freeware remake with updated graphics/music.

projects.name: Chuckie Egg HTML5 (repton3.co.uk)
projects.note: Browser remake of BBC Micro version.

projects.name: Chuckie Egg 2007 remake (Jozsef Laszlo)
projects.note: Assembler/Pascal remake with level editor (unverified details).

chuckieegg.official_modern: None official modern (mobile 'Chuckie Egg' by ZedZed is an unofficial/fan remake, unverified).
chuckieegg.gap_note: Only 2000s freeware and web clones; nothing open-source maintained or modern.

projects.name: Manic Miner PC (Retrospec)
projects.note: Classic Retrospec freeware remake with enhanced graphics/sound.

projects.name: Manic Miner disassembly (SkoolKit)
projects.note: Fully annotated disassembly; basis for ports.

projects.name: Manic Miner for Windows (muckypaws)
projects.note: Retro remake (unverified details).

projects.name: Pachi el Marciano
projects.note: Open Manic-Miner-like platformer.

manicminer.official_modern: No modern official remake (Matthew Smith / Software Projects rights; appears in ZX Spectrum Next / TheSpectrum bundles).
manicminer.gap_note: Only freeware/retro remakes and disassemblies; no open, modern-looking version.

projects.name: Neverball
projects.note: 3D tilt-the-world ball game with editor (Radiant maps); 1.6.x releases; clean but modest 3D visuals.

projects.name: Trackballs
projects.note: Explicitly Marble Madness-inspired 3D game with level editor; dated look.

projects.name: Marble Marcher (+ Community Edition)
projects.note: Ray-marched fractal marble racing with striking modern visuals; CE adds editor.

marblemadness.official_modern: No official remake; commercial successors like Marble It Up (2018) and Super Monkey Ball.
marblemadness.gap_note: Open 3D marble games exist (Neverball, Trackballs) and Marble Marcher has premium visuals, but none recreates the isometric Marble Madness race-course design with modern polish.

projects.name: Dust Racing 2D
projects.note: Top-down racer with Qt/OpenGL, AI, split-screen, track editor; press compared it to Super Sprint.

projects.name: PySprint
projects.note: Recreation of Atari ST Super Sprint in Pygame.

projects.name: Super Sprint Remake in UE5
projects.note: Student UE5 project, only 2 tracks.

supersprint.official_modern: No standalone modern remake; included in Atari compilations (Atari 50, Midway Arcade Treasures).
supersprint.gap_note: Dust Racing 2D is a good open top-down racer but visually modest; no open, modern-looking arcade single-screen Super Sprint.

projects.name: Javascript Gauntlet
projects.note: Well-known HTML5 Gauntlet clone, simple pixel art.

projects.name: Fight Or Perish
projects.note: Dandy/Gauntlet-style maze action.

projects.name: rogue-gauntlet
projects.note: 3D Gauntlet-inspired roguelike; early hobby project.

gauntlet.official_modern: Gauntlet (Arrowhead/WB, 2014) / Gauntlet Slayer Edition; Gauntlet in Midway/Atari compilations.
gauntlet.gap_note: No complete, maintained open Gauntlet clone exists; only dated or experimental hobby projects.

projects.name: game_paperboy (donxito)
projects.note: Small browser remake.

projects.name: Paperboy Remake University Project
projects.note: Student project.

paperboy.gap_note: Essentially nothing beyond student/hobby experiments; entirely unoccupied space.

projects.name: Xenon 2000: Project PCF
projects.note: Official free one-level remake by Bitmap Brothers for PC Format; enhanced 2000-era graphics.

projects.name: TypeScript Xenon
projects.note: Semi-playable browser remake.

projects.name: Phavon
projects.note: Semi-playable remake with commercial content.

projects.name: Chromium B.S.U.
projects.note: Open OpenGL vertical shooter; not Xenon-specific.

xenon2.official_modern: Xenon 2 Megablast in Bitmap Brothers Collection (Evercade), no modern remake; Xenon 2000 was official freeware.
xenon2.gap_note: Only semi-playable ports and an official 2000 freeware one-level remake; no open, complete, modern-looking version.

projects.name: Speedball 2 remake (Kroah, bringerp)
projects.note: Reverse-engineered prototype from Atari ST version.

projects.name: DCSpeedBall2
projects.note: Released source of the Pocket PC/Dreamcast port.

speedball2.official_modern: Speedball 2 Evolution (2011), Speedball 2 HD (2013), Speedball 2 Tournament (2007), Brutal Deluxe on Evercade; Rebellion owns rights.
speedball2.gap_note: Only reverse-engineered ports needing original assets; nothing free, open and modern.

projects.name: PipeNightDreams
projects.note: Classic SDL Pipe Mania clone.

projects.name: Pipe Puzzle (tassaron)
projects.note: Simple browser clone.

projects.name: CoolDown
projects.note: Free-content pipe puzzle.

pipemania.official_modern: Pipe Mania (2008, Empire Interactive, multi-platform remake); countless mobile clones.
pipemania.gap_note: Only dated or minimal clones; no modern-presentation free version.
